title: Look Before You Lift: Visual and Quantitative Diagnostics for Topological Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15388v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Topological deep learning (TDL) methods rely on lifting raw data into higher-order discrete domains such as simplicial complexes, cell complexes, and hypergraphs. In practice, this lifting step is often treated as a black box: practitioners select a lifting and then tune architectures, with limited visibility into whether the induced higher-order connectivity is meaningful for the downstream task. To address this missing diagnostic layer, we propose a visualization technique called TopoExplorer that leverages the strictly augmented Hasse graph form of topological datasets for exploratory data analysis. For the first time, practitioners can easily visualize the incidence- and adjacency-based neighborhoods that define the lifted dataset, as well as read off key graph metrics that describe its structural and feature landscape. translated_title: 先看再举：拓扑深度学习的可视化与定量诊断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15388v1 公告类型：新 摘要：拓扑深度学习方法依赖于将原始数据提升到高阶离散域，如单纯复形、胞腔复形和超图。在实践中，这一提升步骤通常被视为黑箱：从业者选择一种提升方式，然后调整架构，但对诱导的高阶连接是否对下游任务有意义，可见性有限。为解决这一缺失的诊断层，我们提出了一种名为TopoExplorer的可视化技术，该技术利用拓扑数据集的严格增广Hasse图形式进行探索性数据分析。首次，从业者可以轻松可视化定义提升数据集的关联和邻域，以及读取描述其结构和特征景观的关键图指标。通过在多个数据集和提升方式上的大量实验，我们展示了其中几个指标的相关性。
tldr: 本文提出TopoExplorer，一种基于增广Hasse图的可视化诊断工具，首次让从业者能直观检查拓扑深度学习中的提升步骤，并通过图指标揭示其结构相关性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TopoExplorer, a visualization diagnostic tool based on augmented Hasse graphs, enabling practitioners to intuitively inspect the lifting step in topological deep learning and reveal structural relevance via graph metrics.
